fields.Name: T137 - Create Label Wizard Multi-Step Flow
fields.Description: Drives the 3-step mj-label-create wizard overlay (Entity→Records→Details progression) which is a bespoke creation flow, and is fully data-agnostic because the entity picker is populated from always-present metadata.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → Labels surface, click 'Create Label'. Confirm a wizard overlay opens showing a 3-step indicator (Entity → Records → Details) with a searchable entity list on step 1. Search for an entity (e.g. 'Users') and click it, confirming the wizard advances to the Records step. Seeing the wizard render and advance one step is success — you do NOT need to finish creating a label. Then close/cancel the wizard. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking Create Label opens a wizard with a 3-step indicator (Entity, Records, Details)
Step 1 shows a searchable entity list; selecting an entity advances to the Records step
The wizard can be closed or canceled and returns to the Labels list
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
